memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Problems:
- Glaucoma
  - Status: IOP 22 mmHg OD, 21 mmHg OS on current timolol and latanoprost; asymptomatic.
  - Plan: Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD; latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS; monitor IOP in 3 months.
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: GAD-7 score 8 (mild); on escitalopram 5 mg OD and buspirone 5 mg BD; reports occasional worry.
  - Plan: Continue current meds; consider CBT referral if symptoms worsen.
- Atrial fibrillation
  - Status: In sinus rhythm on ECG; on apixaban 5 mg BD; no overt heart failure.
  - Plan: Continue apixaban; check renal function and INR if warfarin considered.
Weight 62 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm – within limit).
Diet advice: Breakfast – low‑salt, whole grain; Lunch – vegetables, lean protein; Dinner – light, early.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
